summary: Ostin Technology Group Co., Ltd., a foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K with the SEC to report its unaudited financial results for the six months ended March 31, 2026 and discuss recent corporate developments. The filing includes management's discussion and analysis, condensed consolidated financial statements, and inline XBRL data. No special-situations event is disclosed. The report also incorporates forward-looking statements and incorporates the filing by reference into an existing F-3 registration statement. As a routine earnings update, this filing does not qualify as a special situation.
